verdict.rationale: The IRS documents real machine-to-machine channels: MeF, an XML system-to-system e-file channel with versioned schemas, the Publication 4164 developer guide and the ATS test environment, plus the IRIS A2A intake for information returns. These channels are credentialed rather than public: access requires e-file provider enrollment (up to 45 days, possible fingerprinting) or a Transmitter Control Code, and schemas and WSDLs are registration-gated, with no OpenAPI and no developer.irs.gov. Missing for 10: openly accessible public API, publicly downloadable machine-readable interface definitions, an interactive API reference, a public deprecation policy, and API coverage of core services such as EIN, payments and account access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
